BME-10.reason: No defined carrier, coagulation-control or immune mechanism supplies the complete indefinite blood-function substitute; it is not treated as an automatic hemorrhage-control device.

CLM-01.reason: The systemic-aging master-pathway ambition overlaps LON-01. A complete aging-reversal goal is not a separate causal input to another complete aging-reversal goal.

CLM-04.reason: The original source explicitly flags equivalence to BME-01. Retain the duplicate metadata, not a goal-to-goal causal arrow.

CLM-06.reason: The liquid-biopsy ambition overlaps ONC-06; an imaging scanner does not establish a blood-based detection test or its specificity.

CLM-10.reason: The programmable antigen-tolerance platform overlaps IMM-09’s safe antigen-specific tolerance ambition; no separate intervening mechanism is specified.

PHA-02.reason: No specific orally delivered candidate and its target behavior are supplied. Better oral transport alone does not establish a listed root-cause cure.

PHA-06.reason: Resetting opioid tolerance does not create a non-opioid analgesic or remove every addiction pathway. A qualified disease-specific use still needs review.

ANS-02.reason: The non-addictive analgesic ambition overlaps CLM-05/EMR-09 at the outcome level but supplies no distinct molecular target to make a causal sequence.

ANS-03.reason: No qualified causal intervention for postoperative cognitive dysfunction is specified. A general sleep, memory or consciousness model is not prevention evidence.

ANS-06.reason: The difficult-airway device overlaps EMR-07’s airway goal. No reviewed airway geometry, ventilation or rescue mechanism establishes universal success.

EMR-01.reason: No defined resuscitation mechanism in the collection simultaneously restores circulation and all neurological function for every arrest cause.

EMR-04.reason: No qualified local/systemic hemostatic-control mechanism establishes stopping all bleeding without remote thrombosis; generic blood replacement does not suffice.

EMR-07.reason: This airway ambition overlaps ANS-06 while imposing non-invasive success. Neither complete airway outcome supplies a device mechanism for the other.

EMR-09.reason: No specific rapid non-opioid target and pharmacokinetic route are supplied; another complete analgesia aspiration is not a causal input.

SUR-01.reason: The original source flags equivalence to BME-01; keep its identity and duplicate reference without a causal alias arrow.

SUR-05.reason: The original source flags equivalence to BME-06; keep the surgical entry independently accessible, not as a downstream duplicate node.

SUR-08.reason: The source excludes clips, sutures and topical agents but supplies no alternative control mechanism. The emergency topical/systemic-agent ambition does not satisfy that restriction.

ORT-02.reason: No qualified bone-remodeling intervention is specified for rebuilding systemic architecture. General regeneration or cell growth is not a complete osteoporosis mechanism.

ORT-05.reason: The original source flags equivalence to NRL-02. Keep the spinal-regeneration reference as equivalence, not a prerequisite.

ORT-06.reason: The collection does not specify a qualified permanent implant-surface design combining anti-biofilm behavior and lifelong bone integration. A resorbing scaffold is not that surface.

OPH-03.reason: The no-adaptive-optics restriction excludes using the perfect adaptive-optics goal as its solution; no distinct retinal acquisition mechanism was identified.

OPH-09.reason: No reviewed pathway simultaneously supplies gland secretion, goblet cells and stable tear-film behavior; generic growth control does not establish a dry-eye cure.

DER-04.reason: No specific prevention mechanism or antigen design is supplied for all UV-induced and other skin cancers; a broad cancer-vaccine aspiration is not an efficacy argument.

DER-10.reason: Cell-size control does not specify the hair-follicle phase switch or safe lasting activation/suppression, so no growth-to-cycling causal arrow is justified.

rejectedCandidates.reason: The retinal target explicitly excludes adaptive optics.
An imaging device is not the source’s blood-test mechanism.
Loss of awareness is not protective metabolic suppression.
An opioid-tolerance reset does not supply a non-opioid drug.
